name: LLM Gate Companion
shortDescription: Track private LLM Gate budget and usage with local-only API-key storage.
description: A personal Chromium extension for viewing Simra LLM Gate budget, Jalali billing progress, rankings, and date-ranged model usage. The API key stays in local extension storage and is used only for direct, credential-free requests to the configured dashboard endpoints.
features: Local API-key configuration without cookie access
Popup dashboard with Jalali month progress
Spend, remaining budget, requests, and ranking summary
Most-used models by spend and request count
Validated remaining-budget requests
Validated date-ranged spend and request analytics
Partial results when an individual dashboard endpoint fails
installInstructions: Load the unpacked extension during development.
Pin LLM Gate Companion to the browser toolbar and click its icon.
Configure a newly rotated Simra LLM Gate API key in the popup.

name: OpenRouter Daily Deals
shortDescription: Daily OpenRouter model deals plus five developer picks with live pricing, discounts and provider speed.
description: A dependency-free Chrome extension (MV3) that inspects the OpenRouter catalog and surfaces daily deals alongside five computed developer picks: two planning models, three coding models and one separate premium model. It ranks candidates using live prices, active discounts, provider speed (TTFT/throughput), recency within each model series and your GLM → DeepSeek → Gemini → MiMo preference order. Every card shows per-million-token input/output prices, the cost for your selected request size, the provider, discount percentage, time to first token and throughput, with a Nitro recommendation when the faster provider is worth the premium. Everything runs locally: host access is limited to openrouter.ai, settings live in chrome.storage.local and no inference requests are ever sent.
features: Developer picks: 2 planning + 3 coding models plus a separate premium choice
Daily deals view with stronger priority for discounted preferred families
Live provider quotes: input/output prices, discount percentage, per-request cost
Provider speed via the OpenRouter endpoints API with a public provider-table fallback
Nitro guidance: when the fastest provider is worth the price premium
Editorial capability tiers per model family with a recency filter per series
Copy the exact model ID and open the model page in one click
Incremental background scanning with alarms, backoff and six-hour refresh
No API key, no analytics, no remote scripts
installInstructions: Download the ZIP and extract it.
Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Click Load unpacked and select the extracted folder (the one containing manifest.json).
Open the popup — Developer picks is the default tab; the first full scan takes ~12 minutes and refreshes every six hours while Chrome runs.

name: Sazeh DevTools
shortDescription: Inspect and override Sazeh runtime config cached in localStorage — a typed editor instead of hand-editing JSON.
description: Sazeh UI apps fetch remote config and cache it in the page's localStorage under tw-sazeh-<client>-<version>. The service reads that cache once at startup, so trying different config values normally means hand-editing localStorage and reloading. This Chrome extension (MV3, built with Vite + CRXJS + React) turns that into a typed popup editor: it finds every tw-sazeh-* entry in the active tab, unwraps the stale-while-revalidate envelope, and renders fields from a published JSON Schema descriptor when available — or infers them from the live value's runtime types otherwise. Save & Reload writes your edits and pins the override against background revalidation; Reset removes the key so the app fetches fresh config. No remote permissions: it only uses activeTab + scripting, granted when you click the toolbar icon.
features: Detects every tw-sazeh-* config entry in the active tab
Unwraps the stale-while-revalidate envelope ({ value, staleAt, ttl })
Schema-driven typed editor when the app publishes a JSON Schema descriptor
Runtime type inference fallback (boolean → toggle, number → input, string[] → list, …)
Save & Reload pins the override by pushing staleAt ~1 year ahead
Optional 'Keep override' toggle to write without pinning
Reset removes the key so the app fetches fresh config on next load
Zero host permissions — activeTab + scripting only
installInstructions: Download the ZIP and extract it.
Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Click Load unpacked and select the extracted build folder (contains manifest.json).
Open a page where Sazeh has run, click the extension icon, edit, then Save & Reload.
